define i32 @f(i32 %a, i32 %b, i32 %c) {
entry:
  %s = add i32 %a, %b
  %p = mul i32 %s, %c
  %r = sub i32 %p, 3
  ret i32 %r
}

ordering.name: s
ordering.reason: `add` is commutative; either arrival order gives the same result

ordering.name: p
ordering.reason: `mul` is commutative; either arrival order gives the same result

ordering.name: r
ordering.reason: `sub` is order-sensitive, but with a literal subtrahend it is rewritten to commutative `add`, so order no longer matters
